### Confidential by design

Content lives only inside the platform: row-level security, tiled username watermarks, copy and print blocking, and a full audit log of every view.

A purpose-built editor with an insertion toolbar, live preview, snapshot version history, and line-by-line diffs — no external tools needed.

### Realtime collaboration

Built-in chat and a shared milestone timeline keep both parties aligned from kickoff to delivery.

### Fair, agreed terms

A legal confidentiality clause on every project, and a late-decay price both parties set up front — no surprises.

Mandatory mutual reviews after every project build a track record you can trust before you hire.

## Frequently asked questions

HumanizeHub is a freelance marketplace dedicated to humanizing AI-generated content. Content owners post markdown projects, human editors apply, and the entire job — chat, timeline planning, editing, version history, approval, and payment — happens inside the platform under a binding confidentiality agreement.

Your content never appears in the public listing. Payment is an approve-then-pay handshake: the owner reviews the submitted work, approves it, pays the agreed amount, and the worker confirms receipt. Workers can humanize and restyle markdown content into formal prose, casual tone, paragraph-styled documents, presentation-worthy bullet points, slide outlines, academic writing, blog posts, or concise summaries — based on the custom style brief the owner sets.
